scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix backend & npm run dev --prefix frontend & npm run dev --prefix admin
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix admin && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix admin
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix admin
scripts.build:cwp: npm run build && mkdir -p deploy_cwp/backend deploy_cwp/frontend && cp -r backend/dist backend/package.json backend/package-lock.json deploy_cwp/backend/ && cp -r frontend/dist deploy_cwp/frontend/ && cd deploy_cwp && zip -r deploy.zip .
